faq.a: A contract in which a buyer agrees in advance to purchase a mine's future output. SDRC announced a firm gold offtake agreement with Ocean Partners on Aug 4, 2026, so a buyer is lined up for its material.

An independent technical report, prepared by a qualified professional, that estimates how much metal is in the ground and how confident that estimate is. SDRC's July 29, 2026 news release referenced a planned November 43-101.
OTC companies typically publish quarterly reports within about 45 days of quarter end, so Q3 2026 updates are generally expected around mid-November.
The U.S. Mine Safety and Health Administration routinely inspects active mines. SDRC published a statement about its MSHA inspections on Oct 20, 2026.

faq.q: What does XTPT's PCAOB audit mean?
faq.a: American Antimony completed an independent audit under PCAOB standards (Sep 17, 2026), which the company described as initiating its next phase of corporate development.
